resources.string: Waiting for the BatteryRemapper hook inside System UI to respond…
The module is loaded and responding inside System UI.
Enable BatteryRemapper in LSPosed, select System UI in the module scope, and then restart System UI using the refresh button above.
Tap this card to check again.
Displays the physical 20–80% battery range as 0–100%. Turn this off to show the original battery percentage.
Turns Battery Saver on at 20% displayed battery and turns it off above 50%. Battery Saver remains off while charging.
Starts a 30-second shutdown countdown at 20% physical battery. Connecting a charger cancels the countdown.
Battery Saver and shutdown automation are available only while battery remapping is enabled.
The status bar, Quick Settings, notifications, and lock screen controls may disappear briefly while System UI restarts. Root access is required.
System UI could not be restarted. Make sure root access was granted, then try again.
A System UI restart is already in progress.
Battery remapping is now enabled. Restart System UI to apply the remapped percentage.
Battery remapping is now disabled. Restart System UI to restore the original battery percentage.
